def: a joiner, i.e. brace or cramp

occurrences.text: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;
Even to the artificers and builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
